method: Four coherent base scenes, each refined in nine overlapping 576x384 crops to native 1536x1024; registered and blended to 4096x2731.

scenes.text: A sleeping waterwheel in a busy medieval riverside mill village. ONE enormous stationary wooden waterwheel at center-left, mill house, winding stream through center, winding stone footpaths, footbridges, flour mill courtyard, outdoor bakery, orchard, laundry lines, fishpond, children, baskets, workbenches. Whole scene continuous at elevated oblique angle. Specific search details distributed far apart across the WHOLE image: exactly THREE brown squirrels carrying one bright red apple each (one on upper-left mill roof, one at far right orchard, one beside lower-left bridge). Other squirrels may hold nuts but no apples. A white cat asleep INSIDE a blue wheelbarrow in lower-right bakery courtyard. A long unmistakable RED hose snakes from a hand pump near center across stone ground to a bed of YELLOW flowers near lower edge; other green watering cans elsewhere. A baker puts bread into an oven, ducks in stream, folk repairing a gate, tiny mushrooms, gears and neat tools. No other red apples in animals' hands.

A magical woodland village in gentle twilight mist, readable bright detail not dark. One continuous landscape with winding stream and paths, tall inhabited trees with platforms and bridges at upper left, lantern-maker workshop at lower right, little waterside dock center, flower garden and tea party lower left. Specific search details distributed across WHOLE scene: exactly THREE white owls each carrying a small BLUE ribbon in its beak (one on high left branch, one on lower-left fence, one on far-right rooftop); other birds have empty beaks. One fox asleep UNDER a curved wooden bridge spanning the stream. One little red boat tied to the dock contains a pair of green boots and a fishing net. Many background life details, people repairing lamps, mushrooms, moths, leaves, kettles, baskets, stars, hanging laundry. No repeated candidate grid, no panels.

A spectacular continuous mountain sanctuary above waterfalls with winding paths linking cliff terraces, stone arches, rope bridge, dragon nests among flowers, little keepers tending gardens, waterfall crossing from upper middle to lower right. At least EIGHT friendly full-bodied dragons scattered widely, different clear colors, each anatomically coherent with four legs two wings one head one tail. Specific search targets: exactly TWO dragons SLEEP curled with their heads resting down, one far upper left blue dragon, one lower-right golden dragon; all other dragons have heads visibly raised and eyes open. One distinctive red-and-pink dragon with black stripes and a long tail at middle-right plays with a BLUE ball (no other balls). A large open nest far lower left holds THREE green eggs and ONE purple egg, clear separate eggs; other nests elsewhere with pale eggs. Lots of small details scattered throughout: birds, flags, butterflies, food baskets, keepers, hanging ropes, flowers, fish in pools. No candidate lineup or panels.

A continuous bright celebratory medieval river town, river now flowing through a great ornate stone river gate at upper center, festival on both banks, two bridges at different levels, musicians on lower-left square, garden right, little boats on river, bakery, rooftops, children playing, gold bells and flowers. Specific search details spread across WHOLE scene: exactly THREE small toy wooden boats with RED sails (one far upper-left inlet, one near middle-right bank, one lower-left foreground water); other boats have BLUE or WHITE sails. A brown dog at right garden is carrying a GREEN shoe in its mouth, clearly separated natural limbs. A girl in yellow at lower-right is flying a RED kite; the kite high upper-right has a visibly continuous taut string all the way to her raised hand. Another boy flying a blue kite on opposite bank. Colorful detailed lively festivities, people and tools, tiny distinct props, no repeatedcandidategrid. Anatomy simple and correct.

detailPrompts.mistAndNest: Enhance this EXACT image crop to crisp highly detailed 1536x1024. This is an overlapping crop of ONE continuous search picture that must stitch to neighboring crops. Preserve EXACT composition, perspective, framing, object silhouettes, positions, colors, counts and boundaries. Do not add or remove animals, people, eggs, ribbons, balls, sails or other objects. Correct malformed anatomy only, with simple natural hands, one head and one tail per animal. Retain sleeping versus awake poses exactly. Retain ribbons in birds' beaks and items in boats. Add fine clean storybook ink and gouache detail, crisp leaves, feathers, scales, stone joints, flowers, wood grain. No panel borders, no text, no changed camera. Fill canvas with exactly the same scene crop.

basePrefix: Create a single seamless highly detailed Wimmelbild search-and-find illustration, landscape 3:2, full bleed, no text, numbers, border, collage, panels or grid. Clean precise storybook ink and gouache, crisp individual objects, warm rich colors, consistent perspective and sunlight, readable small anatomically correct people and animals. Compose a single connected place with many things to discover throughout all edges, no oversized foreground protagonist. Avoid malformed hands, faces, hybrid animals.
